evidence.claim: Steady lift is rho Gamma V cross s; V is the total relative velocity at the bound-vortex force point r_hv, not the downstream tangency point.
Glauert-angle midpoint defines sa; nodal position is linearly weighted in sa. The wind-directed quarter-chord midpoint and downstream control point are separate, with h=(dcl/dalpha)/(4pi).
Tangency and stall leakage are evaluated using the control-point quasi-normal; they do not replace the force receiver.
The lift-induced section moment uses the physical chord-direction arm (c/4-xo)c_hat; coefficient Cm contributes along span. This arm is distinct from the wind-directed velocity receiver.
evidence.limit: Do not add a second r_hv-r_axis arm to the already translated section couple.

evidence.classification: explicit integral; discrete self convention unresolved
evidence.claim: Eq160 sums bound and trailing elements of all horseshoes; the text does not prescribe a logical-beam-wide bound omission. It also does not specify the exact diagonal/principal-value rule for an off-segment force receiver.
evidence.limit: Own physical bound exclusion is an implementation convention compatible with zero self induction on a straight filament, not a proved historical off-filament convention.

evidence.claim: Logical beams sharing a physical index use zero mutual vortex core. The guide warns that close inter-beam trailing legs/control points can create serious numerical noise.
evidence.limit: Same physical index does not explicitly mandate identical endpoints, exact Gamma continuity or omission of cross-beam bound segments.

evidence.claim: ASWING5.56 added same-physical-surface membership by turning off the mutual finite core, improving wing/winglet circulation carryover and T-tail endplating.
ASWING5.75 assigns common Loading-plot coordinate to adjacent same-physical-index beams; this is a display statement.
evidence.limit: It does not document merging vortex nodes, averaging hinge frames or excluding adjacent sources.

evidence.claim: Joint equations constrain beam origins and relative orientation; compliant joints modify the angular constraint using the given moment-angle function. No aerodynamic endpoint matching condition is given in these sections.
evidence.limit: Even a coincident structural origin does not alone make its two rotated section quarter-chord points coincide.

evidence.claim: Zero-length structural intervals admit position continuity with angle and load jumps.
evidence.limit: This does not specify a zero-length aerodynamic connector or vortex-node welding rule.

evidence.claim: The2025Avoni Extended User Manual repeats the same-physical-index zero-core rule and its proximity warning; it adds no endpoint-merging or cross-beam exclusion rule in that section.
W sets an external/different-surface core max(ratio*chord,interval_width); for one physical surface it has no effect.
evidence.limit: Changing W is not a source-supported way to regularize this unchanged all-physical-index1 FFWT case.

evidence.claim: K/F fast mode freezes influence matrices at jig geometry and zero alpha/beta; slow mode updates geometry and wind alignment.
evidence.limit: Neither the documented alternative nor better reference agreement proves the historical selection.

evidence.claim: The OPER/K example displays FreezeVL:T and PG0, but the inspected text does not identify that display as the historical FFWT factory/startup state.
Launching ASWING with a case name attempts to read case.set,case.pnt and case.con.
evidence.limit: Absence of those files in today’s bounded archive folder does not establish absence in the original execution directory.

evidence.claim: The same-dated unsteady extension defines the physical chord-vector quarter-chord arm and evaluates steady/unsteady lift velocity there. This differs at finite incidence from steady Eq155 virtual wind-aligned r_hv.
evidence.limit: Crosslink docs/validation/durrant-source-audit.md/.json; not a newly established bug or authorization to replace the steady force receiver.

evidence.classification: explicit conservation; aerodynamic quadrature bridge unknown
evidence.claim: Steady Eqs55-56 use conservative distributed interval loads. They do not separately settle the exact historical mapping between the aerodynamic Glauert sample and structural arithmetic endpoint averages at a hinge.
evidence.limit: Current conservative transfer is an explicit interpretation, not proved ASWING source-code parity.

formulas.steady_receiver_at_pg0: r_hv = r_a + q/|e cross s| * e; q=(1/4-Xax)c
formulas.control_receiver_at_pg0: r_cp = r_hv + h*c/|e cross s| * e; h=(dcl/dalpha)/(4*pi)
formulas.code_endpoint_extension: a=r0+q0/|e cross s0|*e; b=r1+q1/|e cross s1|*e, sampled independently on the two beam sides
formulas.hinge_gap_inference: For coincident beam origins and equal q: endpoint_plus-endpoint_minus = q*(1/|e cross s_plus|-1/|e cross s_minus|)*e. This derives from the current nodal extension; Eq155 itself states only the midpoint construction.
formulas.physical_quarter_chord_arm: delta_r_c4=q*c_hat (steady section-moment Eq72 and unsteady Eq29)
formulas.lift_force_per_length: f_lift=rho*Gamma*(V(r_hv) cross s_hat) in steady Eq67
formulas.whole_beam_exclusion: No inspected primary rule removes all same-beam or same-physical-beam bound contributions.
